subject.title: fix(codex): session permissions persist across resumed turns

question: Should this PR add explicit resumed-turn regression cases for both an OpenClaw exec-policy-owned connection and a supervised connection before merge?
rationale: The central change intentionally makes persisted session state effective after restart; maintainers must decide whether existing owner-boundary coverage is sufficient for that compatibility-sensitive precedence change.

options.title: Add precedence-boundary tests
options.body: Cover resumed bindings where explicit exec policy and supervision must continue to override stored session permissions before merging.

options.title: Accept current coverage
options.body: Merge with the existing focused restore test and live restart proof, accepting the remaining risk that those negative owner-boundary cases are not explicitly demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Add precedence-boundary tests
recommendation.body: Cover resumed bindings where explicit exec policy and supervision must continue to override stored session permissions before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the current permission-precedence implementation and associated live proof.
